{#- The icon font in this theme's static directory is a cut-down copy of the parent theme's, at the same path so that it simply replaces it: one face, one file, no competing declarations. Twenty-four glyphs rather than some 1,400 — 2.5 KB rather than 152.7 KB. Counting them takes two passes. Thirteen appear as fa- classes in the markup; the rest the theme sets from custom properties — admonition icons, version-modified markers, the external-link mark — which no scan of the HTML can see. A glyph left out does not fail visibly: the browser fetches a face that can draw it, which is how the omission was caught. Regenerating it: uv run --with "fonttools[woff]" fonttools subset --flavor=woff2 --layout-features= --no-hinting --desubroutinize --unicodes=F002,F010,F019,F03A,F042,F057,F058,F05A,F062,F064, F06A,F071,F078,F09B,F0C9,F0EB,F0F3,F104,F105,F15B,F185,F186,F1C1,F296,F303,F35D --output-file=docs/_themes/serena/static/vendor/fontawesome/6.5.2/webfonts/fa-solid-900.woff2 Two of those, github and gitlab, live in the brands face and are absent from the result; nothing here draws them. Separately, the parent theme delivers FontAwesome twice over: as a stylesheet with webfonts in the head, and again at the end of the body as the SVG-with-JS kit, which is the larger of the two by an order of magnitude. Either one draws every icon on this site, so the stylesheet is kept and the kit dropped — along with the preloads for the two font faces no page here uses a glyph from. The theme preloads all three unconditionally. Both blocks are rendered by the parent and then filtered, rather than reproduced here: the asset digests stay the parent's business, and anything it adds to either block keeps arriving untouched. -#} {#- Named rather than "!layout.html": the exclamation mark only skips templates_path, not this theme, so it would resolve straight back here. Themes chain by name, which the loader resolves because it searches each theme directory's parent — the same way sphinx-book-theme reaches pydata_sphinx_theme/layout.html. -#} {%- extends "sphinx_book_theme/layout.html" %} {%- macro without_duplicate_fontawesome(rendered) -%} {%- for line in rendered.split("\n") -%} {%- set is_duplicate = "all.min.js" in line or "fa-brands-400.woff2" in line or "fa-regular-400.woff2" in line -%} {%- if not is_duplicate %}{{ line }} {% endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- endmacro -%} {%- block css %}{{ without_duplicate_fontawesome(super()) }} {% endblock css %} {%- block scripts_end %}{{ without_duplicate_fontawesome(super()) }}{% endblock scripts_end %}
